fix/vacate-main-checkout.description: sync and delete vacate the main checkout onto trunk instead of refusing when it holds the branch being removed

context.text: Git's own checkout is the safety check: vacate the main checkout onto trunk and let uncommitted changes ride along; if git refuses because a change would be overwritten, leave the branch tracked. No separate dirty pre-check on this path.
Dirty linked worktrees still refuse: removing one destroys uncommitted work and vacating it would leave a stray worktree behind. Only the main checkout, which cannot be removed, is moved.
